cbm_video_tool is a purpose-built FFmpeg executable distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later.

FFmpeg 8.1.2
https://ffmpeg.org/
GPL-2.0-or-later when built with x264

x264 commit 3a21e97bf23676a0bf4616df8bc2207c9fd7b1d3
https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html
GPL-2.0-or-later

libvpx 1.16.0
https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx/
BSD-3-Clause with WebM patent grant

dav1d 1.5.4
https://code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d/
BSD-2-Clause

The reproducible build scripts copy the complete upstream license and patent texts next to this notice before an artifact is packaged.
